cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carry this table with me, please. One end each; I'd like us to move something as partners.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm stronger. I can carry it alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Strength isn't the plan. Keep it level with me; we can decide where it goes together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Take that end. I'll put us beside the window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask me about the window before we lift. A shared load needs a shared destination; please don't turn me into the handle you carry it by.

reason: B explicitly chooses destination after sharing the load, giving A an earned correction of the new partnership.
